faces.transcription: No further information. No information at all, really.
faces.flavor: Fighting off the rabid wolverines, you somehow manage to make it back to Langley. "My word," Coop says, his eyes going wide. "You mean to tell me that the cure for the MEDUSA plague is rhubarb pie!? Why, that's the most remarkable pearl of knowledge I've ever encountered! It's nigh utopian!"
